description: Component for ingesting Google Ads data using dlt - returns DataFrames.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset that will hold the Google Ads data

customer_id.label: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Google Ads Customer ID (10-digit number, format: XXX-XXX-XXXX or XXXXXXXXXX)

developer_token.label: Developer Token
developer_token.description: Google Ads API Developer Token. Use ${GOOGLE_ADS_DEV_TOKEN} for env vars.

client_id.label: Client Id
client_id.description: Google OAuth Client ID. Use ${GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID} for env vars.

client_secret.label: Client Secret
client_secret.description: Google OAuth Client Secret. Use ${GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET} for env vars.

refresh_token.label: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: Google OAuth Refresh Token. Use ${GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN} for env vars.

use_service_account.label: Use Service Account
use_service_account.description: Use service account instead of OAuth credentials

project_id.label: Project Id
project_id.description: Google Cloud Project ID (for service account auth)

service_account_email.label: Service Account Email
service_account_email.description: Service account email (for service account auth)

private_key.label: Private Key
private_key.description: Service account private key (for service account auth).

impersonated_email.label: Impersonated Email
impersonated_email.description: Email to impersonate for service account delegation

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: Comma-separated list of resources to extract: customers, campaigns, ad_groups, ads, keywords, change_events

start_date.label: Start Date
start_date.description: Start date for performance metrics (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days ago.

end_date.label: End Date
end_date.description: End date for performance metrics (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: How many rows to include in the preview. Large tables (>10× this number) are sampled randomly.

destination.label: Destination
destination.description: dlt destination identifier (e.g. 'snowflake', 'bigquery', 'postgres', 'redshift', 'filesystem', 'duckdb', 'databricks', 'athena', 'clickhouse', 'mssql', 'motherduck'). Leave empty for in-memory DuckDB → DataFrame mode.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on (e.g. ['raw_orders', 'schema/asset'])

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream columns it derives from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Google Ads Ingestion
